query identity/filter fingerprint no longer matches current interaction
canonical validated working-copy payload exceeds 262144 bytes
installation already has 256 non-expired recoverable copies and request would create another key
checkpoint generation/base key conflicts with a newer recoverable copy

attempted domain save is based on older accepted truth; conflict review required
current owning-domain projection says action is unavailable

presentation_rule: Transport/domain error codes remain owned by their packet. LLD-10 maps them to accessible presentation but never renames a domain failure into success.
